in_sanskrit.name: जगन्नाथ
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: जगत् (jagat) - Universe, नाथ (nath) - Lord, प्रभव (prabhava) - Source of Creation, प्रभवन्त (prabhavanta) - One who bestows boons

in_hindi.name: जगन्नाथ
in_hindi.long_meaning: सर्व (sarv) - All, विशेष (vishesh) - Special, ज्ञान (jnana) - Knowledge, अवतार (avatar) - Incarnation

in_tamil.name: ஜகந்நாத்
in_tamil.long_meaning: ஜகத் (jagat) - Universe, நாத் (nath) - Lord, அன்பவன் (anbavan) - One who is full of love and compassion

in_telugu.name: జగన్నాథ
in_telugu.long_meaning: జగద్ (jagad) - Universe, నాథ (nath) - Lord, ప్రభవ (prabhava) - Source of Creation, ప్రభవన్త (prabhavanta) - One who bestows boons

in_marathi.name: Jagannath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jagannath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jagannath refers to Lord Krishna or Lord Vishnu, the supreme ruler and controller of the universe. This powerful name signifies protection, strength, and the ultimate authority.

in_bengali.name: Jagannath
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the Universe
in_bengali.long_meaning: Jagannath একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Jagannath refers to Lord Krishna or Lord Vishnu, the supreme ruler and controller of the universe. This powerful name signifies protection, strength, and the ultimate authority.

vedic_reference.note: Jagannath is the presiding deity of the Puri Jagannath Temple, one of the most famous and ancient temples in India. He is an avatar of Lord Vishnu and is worshipped as the Lord of the Universe.
